revised_trade.thesis: FACT: On 2026-09-16 the Fed raised 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; futures had entered that decision with >90% odds of the hike. FACT: US 2Y is 4.76 as of 2026-09-18 (executable_marks.rates.US_2Y / market_state.rates.US.tenors.2Y.value), 1y percentile 99.80, z_1y 2.84, 5y percentile 88.0, z_5y 0.89, with bp_1d +9.0 (screen 1D z 1.90), bp_1m +57.0 (screen 1M z 3.29), bp_5d +13.0. INFERENCE: The 1-month 3.3σ US 2Y cheapening is crowded extrapolation of already-known CPI-plus-hike information; known information needs a new transmission mechanism to justify another 9bp cheapening two sessions after the decision. The economically relevant anchor is the policy rate, not the 5y yield percentile: 4.76 sits ~76-101bp above the new funds band after a single 25bp step. paper_capital.funding_hurdle_rationale: The seat pays 5.00% ACT/365 on the full $100m every day whether flat or deployed (~$13.7k/day). Being flat has zero expected trading P&L against that vig. Long US_2Y at the frozen 4.76 mark: books P&L is inverted yield, so a 25bp giveback on $80m is 0.25/100*80m=$200k (~15 days of funding) and a 35bp giveback is $280k (~20 days). The 1-month +57bp / z 3.29 cheapening after a priced hike is large enough that a partial mean-reversion inside 2-6 weeks can clear the clock; $80m is sized up because percent-quoted 2Y P&L per bp is small. Carry of receiving 4.76 versus the 3.75-4.00% funds band supports the position while waiting. If the 5y z of 0.89 is the true regime and yields do not give back, the trade fails the hurdle and is invalidated by a fresh hawkish print rather than by sitting flat.
